Class ToolkitUiRegistry

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.swing.toolkit.render.ToolkitUiRegistry
public class ToolkitUiRegistry extends Object
A singleton registry for mapping toolkit classes to their specialized ToolkitUI strategies.

Manages the resolution of both specialized tree nodes and detail panels for toolkits, supporting hierarchical lookup using ClassHierarchyMap.

anahata
